descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-09 All Residents Attendance Toggle (Nursing Home only) · S05 「现成的 spec：已有 / 新 / 有疑问的行、汇总那一行和重复核对面板」 Existing spec: known / new / doubtful rows, the summary line and the duplicate review sheet

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U3 The photo uses the same deduplication against All Residents as TC-02. Before anything is written, the physician sees how many residents are already known and how many are new (e.g. …（UAT TC-09；UAT TC-02 (by reference)；TFA-92587 AC 3）

测试设计方法：决策表（decision-table） — 几个条件的组合列成表，每个组合各验一次，看结果是不是按规则变。

Given A linked resident not In Today, a resident In Today, and a mocked photo read with an existing row, a new row and a row whose MRN matches but whose name conflicts

When Scan, read the summary, add, and settle the doubtful row as the same resident

Then Rows are classed known / new / review with the summary line, and the doubtful row goes to the 'Possible duplicate residents' sheet. After it is settled as the same resident, the known resident is linked, not duplicated, and the new one is created. All Residents keeps everyone

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：Playwright assertions in patient-list-capture.spec.ts (summary '1 already in All Residents · 1 new · 1 to review', 'Possible duplicate residents' dialog, All Residents). The test asserts nothing while the dialog is open, so it is not evidence that nothing is written before the decision (that is S18). …

在哪跑：本地 lane A（现成 Playwright 测试）；测试方法 PW · Playwright 脚本；矩阵里排的车道 现成测试（Tim 的 Playwright）（automated）

S05 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-09.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：本地 — main e02167f，本地栈（local stack, not a deployed build）；run folder runs/2026-10-14-local，lane A。

测试方法：PW · Playwright 脚本；辅助：AGENT · 浏览器 agent — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 local 跑；来源：matrix（lane A）。
